verdict.rationale: Langfuse's observability docs say traces capture the exact prompt, the model's response, token usage and latency for every request. Capture works through native Python/JS SDKs, 100+ integrations, OpenTelemetry or LiteLLM, with token usage and cost tracked automatically for popular models. Community users independently report relying on its tracing to debug production LLM infrastructure. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of token-usage and latency capture specifically, and smoother instrumentation for some providers (one user reported the recommended Claude instrumentation approach did not work).

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture traces of my LLM calls with inputs, outputs, latency, and token usage

citations.quote: structured logs of every request that capture the exact prompt sent, the model's response, token usage, latency, and any tools or retrieval steps in between
Capture traces via our native SDKs for Python/JS, 100+ library/framework integrations, OpenTelemetry, or via an LLM Gateway such as LiteLLM
most integrations capture usage and cost automatically
Traces include all LLM and non-LLM calls, including retrieval, embedding, API calls, and more
